reason_for_35_fps: The previously measured quick-settings cache plugin was replaced with the packaged plugin during cleanup.

controlled_same_stack.interpretation: Replacing the plugin reproduces and reverses the regression. These are DRM presentation events, not optical FPS.

restored_source.resource_identity: Recovered ActionDrawer and QuickSettingsPanel sources match the actual plugin resources byte for byte; the older QML import-path prototype differs and is excluded.
restored_source.qt_identity: Stripping the saved Qt candidate produces exactly the installed library SHA-256 e92cb3a71a284f7e8d2fc5a6510174610ea22f16bd670ac3f919c4e8e133b498.

preserved_fixes.kernel: All main Linux patches remain unchanged, including unified DRM/shared VM, touch release, WCN3660, charging, card detect, A3xx ring suspend, MPM/L2, MDP5 resources and registers, active-only memory votes, USB/MMSS clocks and balanced OCMEM restore. Module checksum/build ID and callbacks are checked on device.
preserved_fixes.mesa: Main patches 0001/0002/0009/0010/0011/0012 remain unchanged; installed files have a verified manifest.
preserved_fixes.qt: Active depth/stencil discard binary preserved; source promoted out of candidates.
preserved_fixes.shell_cache: Recovered and restored; this is the demonstrated lost active optimization.
preserved_fixes.wifi_history: Deleted earlier Wi-Fi patches were consolidated into main patch 0123, whose description lists the former components; no source loss found.
preserved_fixes.limitations: This audit does not re-test every radio, charging or thermal function. Remaining GPU restart faults, whole-SoC XO/VMIN and stable 60 FPS are not declared solved.

candidate_disposition.promoted: Mesa 0003/0005/0008 already integrated as main 0010/0011/0012; Qt 0001 promoted here.
candidate_disposition.removed: All remaining patches/candidates are removed from the current tree; historical source remains in Git commit 43648a2. Failed PHY, suspend tracing, shader/tile/scissor experiments and unqualified FM are not in production.

excluded_trial: Repeated live shell restarts produced a GPU hang; that run was rejected. Fresh-boot canonical stack passed mapping/hash/journal checks, measured 51.251 FPS and passed s2idle/RPM pixel and phase-counter checks.
